subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows receipts and expenditure by a business firm over 5 years.

Gain = Receipts - Expenditure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b604cd8bdcb9b265e69f0629d206f4a020e7d2e73017cf9a0572a3d967f5b74.png] 

In which year did the company gain the minimum amount?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Company gain in 2016 = 54 - 51 = 3

Company gain in 2017 = 64 - 60 = 4

Company gain in 2018 = 80 - 75 = 5

Company gain in 2019 = 82 - 80 = 2

Company gain in 2020 = 98 - 87 = 11

Company gain the minimum amount in 2019.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
